text:
maria: Heads-up — prepping a quick cost scrub for Acadia's product spotlight next Tue. Embedding rollout could spike tokens. Need QBR numbers + alert plan. @kevin can you confirm expected user seats / perf test ramp?
kevin: They told us ~3k DAU beta, 10k queries/day peak. embedding calls avg 750 tokens/req. Rough forecast = ~7M tokens/day peak. :grimacing:
lina: product wants 2-week gradual ramp starting Mon. We'll run canary at 10% first 48h.
ashley: Support will watch channels. Can we set a credit threshold alert and throttle plan?
maria: propose alert at $3k daily burn, escalation to acct team at $5k. Also set embedding-rate limit to 15rps for canary. Thoughts?
kevin: $3k/day seems tight, but ok for QBR narrative. Add automatic fallback to smaller-quant model on throttle?
maria: yes — routing policy: if embed-model cost>threshold -> route to quantized-embed-v1. Add failure metric: >5% 429s -> rollback.
billing-bot: automatic alert created: threshold=$3000/day, escalation=@kevin,@maria at $5000/day. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acadia-spotlight
ryan: Can we get a short spend forecast table to include in QBR slide? I can mock quick numbers if you want.
maria: please. Need 7d and 30d forecast, per-route cost, and recommended mitigations. Keep it 1 slide.
ryan: will send a draft by EOD. sample snippets: 
```
7d peak tokens: 49M
30d peak tokens: 210M
est. monthly cost (hosted): ~$18.5k
```
maria: perfect. Also capture customer feedback ask: product wants to know latency at 95th pct for embed calls under 15rps — add to enablement checklist.
lina: noted. I'll add to release doc and ask infra for perf traces.
kevin: I'll loop in acct exec for renewal discussion — this product could justify an annual commit.
ashley: capturing support FAQs now — will push to intercom playbook.
maria: great team — final action list: ryan draft slide, billing-bot confirm alerts, lina update release doc, ashley add FAQ, kevin prep renewal ask. Check-in tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
